## Deployed Apps

Self-deployed R/Pharmaverse/Teal/Shiny apps with clinical trial data:

- [Exploratory analysis - Teal](https://dror.shinyapps.io/exploratory_1/)
- [Safety - Teal](https://dror.shinyapps.io/safety_2/)
- [Efficacy - Teal](https://dror.shinyapps.io/efficacy_3/)

## Code Examples

Code examples:

- [ComplexHeatmap + Teal](https://drorberel.github.io/ComplexHeatmapTeal/) - Demonstration of integrating HtmlWidget JS wrapper visualizations into Teal apps
- [shiny_workshop](https://github.com/drorberel/shiny_workshop)
- [Bioc2mlr](https://github.com/drorberel/Bioc2mlr) - Biomarker discovery pipeline for multi-omics data using Bioconductor and mlr3
- [JDRFCAV](https://github.com/drorberel/JDRFCAV) - Multi-modal data integration and analysis framework for clinical trial data, including high throughput omics data
